biography.value: Divine Dogs — Ten Shadows shikigami. Summon cost: 1 Cursed Energy. AC and hit points scale with the summoner's proficiency bonus when summoned through the Ten Shadows features.

description.value: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
The dog has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dog's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

biography.value: Gama — Ten Shadows shikigami. Summon cost: 1 Cursed Energy. AC and hit points scale with the summoner's proficiency bonus when summoned through the Ten Shadows features.

description.value: Gama can breathe air and water.
Gama's long jump is up to 20 ft. and its high jump is up to 10 ft., with or without a running start.
The creature is grappled if it is the same size or smaller than Gama (escape DC 11). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained and Gama cannot use its Tongue attack.

biography.value: Nue — Ten Shadows shikigami. Summon cost: 2 Cursed Energy. AC and hit points scale with the summoner's proficiency bonus when summoned through the Ten Shadows features.

description.value: Nue doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
Nue has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

On a hit with Nue, you can spend Cursed Energy up to your proficiency bonus to both deal an additional 1d8 lightning damage and increase the save DC by 1 per CE spent. A creature that fails its save against Nue's electrified wings with this boosted attack also has disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saves for 1 minute and can repeat the save at the beginning of their turns. If you spend at least 3 cursed energy, the target is also stunned until the beginning of their turn on a failed save.
Nue makes two electrified wing attacks.

The target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target cannot take reactions until the start of their turn. If in contact with water, all creatures within 15 ft are targeted by this attack roll.
Nue grapples a willing creature and moves up to half its fly speed.

biography.value: Great Serpent — Ten Shadows shikigami. Summon cost: 4 Cursed Energy. AC and hit points scale with the summoner's proficiency bonus when summoned through the Ten Shadows features.

description.value: If the target is the same size or smaller than Great Serpent it is grappled (escape DC 16). While grappled the target is restrained and Great Serpent can't constrict another target.

biography.value: Rabbit Escape — Ten Shadows shikigami. Summon cost: 6 Cursed Energy. AC and hit points scale with the summoner's proficiency bonus when summoned through the Ten Shadows features.

description.value: Rabbit Escape has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.
The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a rabbit. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.
You can instead spend 1 Cursed Energy to summon a singular rabbit. This rabbit functions according to the Find Familiar spell for 8 hours. You can use this for free once per long rest.
Half as much damage if the swarm has half or less of its hit points.

While occupying a creature's space, Rabbit Escape can give the creature three quarters cover until the beginning of its turn, but any attack that misses because of the cover damages Rabbit Escape. This becomes half cover if the swarm has half or fewer of its hit points.

biography.value: Mourning Tiger — Ten Shadows shikigami. Summon cost: 7 Cursed Energy. AC and hit points scale with the summoner's proficiency bonus when summoned through the Ten Shadows features.

description.value: The Mourning Tiger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

If the Mourning Tiger moves at least 20 ft straight toward a target and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the Mourning Tiger can make a bite attack against it as a bonus action.
The Mourning Tiger can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (2d4) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
The Mourning Tiger makes one attack with its Claw and one attack with its Bite in any order.

All creatures within 30 feet must make a Cursed Energy saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 5d6 psychic damage and is paralyzed until the end of their next turn. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and is not paralyzed.

biography.value: Max Elephant — Ten Shadows shikigami. Summon cost: 8 Cursed Energy. AC and hit points scale with the summoner's proficiency bonus when summoned through the Ten Shadows features.

description.value: If Max Elephant moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the Max Elephant can make a stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

Max Elephant shoots water in a 60 feet cone. Each creature within range must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw, taking 10d6 cold damage and being knocked prone on a failed save or half as much on a successful save.

biography.value: Round Deer — Ten Shadows shikigami. Summon cost: 9 Cursed Energy. AC and hit points scale with the summoner's proficiency bonus when summoned through the Ten Shadows features.

description.value: Round Deer has a pool of Reverse Cursed Energy equal to its Charisma score times your proficiency bonus and regains 10 healing towards its pool at the start of its turn.

Round Deer has a 10 feet aura of reverse cursed energy around it at all times. Round Deer can spend 10 healing from its RCT Pool for each creature within its aura at the start of its turn, healing them for that amount. This aura also functions as an antimagic aura for all creatures other than its summoner. A creature that attempts to use cursed energy must make a DC 15 Cursed Energy check or be unable to use cursed energy while they are within the aura. Round Deer can suppress this aura while concentrating.

As a bonus action or reaction, you can spend Cursed Energy up to your CE modifier to use Reverse Cursed Technique using Round Deer as a point of origin and drawing from its RCT Pool to heal a creature within its aura. You can use 10 points of healing for every 1 cursed energy spent.
Deals an extra 27 (5d10) radiant damage if the target is a cursed spirit.
Round Deer can spend healing from its RCT Pool on a creature within its aura. Round Deer can spend up to 10 times your proficiency bonus at once in increments of 10.
Round Deer can use Reverse Cursed Technique on itself as a reaction to damage.

biography.value: Piercing Ox — Ten Shadows shikigami. Summon cost: 10 Cursed Energy. AC and hit points scale with the summoner's proficiency bonus when summoned through the Ten Shadows features.

description.value: Piercing Ox deals an additional d12 of damage for every 10 feet it moves in a straight line (up to a maximum of 20 additional dice) before hitting a target with its gore.
As a bonus action, Piercing Ox can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

biography.value:
Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga — Ten Shadows shikigami. Summon cost: 20 Cursed Energy. AC and hit points scale with the summoner's proficiency bonus when summoned through the Ten Shadows features.

Adaptation Examples

Damage Types. 2 turns: resistance to the damage. 3 turns: immunity to the damage.

Conditions. 3 turns: immunity to the condition.

Flying Enemy. 1 turn: triples (3×) jump distance. 2 turns: decuples (10×) jump distance. 3 turns: ignores jump distance.

Resistant/Immune Enemy. 2 turns: ignores damage/condition resistance. 3 turns: ignores damage/condition immunity.

Hard to Hit Enemy. 1 turn: +4 to hit against the enemy. 2 turns: +8 to hit. 3 turns: automatically hits the enemy (does not counter techniques).

Impassable Physical Barrier. 2 turns: gains the Incorporeal Movement trait.

Limb Damage Effect. 1 turn: regeneration cost to regenerate limbs is halved. 2 turns: damage to break/remove limbs is doubled. 3 turns: quadrupled. 4 turns: immunity to limb damage effects.

Technique (Saving Throw). 1 turn: +4 to saves against the technique. 2 turns: +8 and advantage. 3 turns: immunity to the technique.

Technique (Defensive). 2 turns: ignores half cover and AC bonuses. 3 turns: ignores three-quarters cover and reduction/redirection effects (Sky Shape). 4 turns: ignores full cover and automatic misses (Infinity).

Soul Damage. 2 turns: regeneration also undoes hit point maximum reduction.

Cursed Energy. 1 turn: gains 50 cursed energy and Cursesight. 2 turns: gains Cursed Strike and Cursed Reinforcement (Skilled). 3 turns: gains Advanced Cursed Energy Manipulation. 4 turns: gains Mastered Cursed Energy Manipulation.

description.value: If Mahoraga fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Mahoraga regains 40 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. Mahoraga can forgo 20 hit points of regeneration to instead regenerate an arm or leg, or 40 hit points of regeneration to instead regenerate the head or torso.

When Mahoraga gains a condition, it removes that condition at the end of its turn and begins adapting to it. After 3 rounds have passed, it becomes immune to that condition.

Damage Types. 2 turns: resistance to the damage. 3 turns: immunity to the damage.

Conditions. 3 turns: immunity to the condition.

Flying Enemy. 1 turn: triples (3×) jump distance. 2 turns: decuples (10×) jump distance. 3 turns: ignores jump distance.

Resistant/Immune Enemy. 2 turns: ignores damage/condition resistance. 3 turns: ignores damage/condition immunity.

Hard to Hit Enemy. 1 turn: +4 to hit against the enemy. 2 turns: +8 to hit. 3 turns: automatically hits the enemy (does not counter techniques).

Impassable Physical Barrier. 2 turns: gains the Incorporeal Movement trait.

Limb Damage Effect. 1 turn: regeneration cost to regenerate limbs is halved. 2 turns: damage to break/remove limbs is doubled. 3 turns: quadrupled. 4 turns: immunity to limb damage effects.

Technique (Saving Throw). 1 turn: +4 to saves against the technique. 2 turns: +8 and advantage. 3 turns: immunity to the technique.

Technique (Defensive). 2 turns: ignores half cover and AC bonuses. 3 turns: ignores three-quarters cover and reduction/redirection effects (Sky Shape). 4 turns: ignores full cover and automatic misses (Infinity).

Soul Damage. 2 turns: regeneration also undoes hit point maximum reduction.

Cursed Energy. 1 turn: gains 50 cursed energy and Cursesight. 2 turns: gains Cursed Strike and Cursed Reinforcement (Skilled). 3 turns: gains Advanced Cursed Energy Manipulation. 4 turns: gains Mastered Cursed Energy Manipulation.

When Mahoraga takes damage, the wheel above its head spins at the end of its turn. Once the wheel has turned twice, Mahoraga has resistance to that damage type. Upon three turns, it gains immunity. Mahoraga can only adapt to one damage type at a time.

Mahoraga possesses the ability to adapt to all phenomena. If Mahoraga encounters an obstruction such as a flying enemy, an obstruction it cannot pass, or a special attack or technique used against it, Mahoraga will begin adapting according to Eight Handled Wheel. Such as through jumping up to the target despite its own movement speed, gaining the Incorporeal Movement trait to move through solid matter, or slowly becoming immune to a certain technique, spell, effect, or ability up to the DM.
Mahoraga makes three attacks with its slam or one attack with its slam and one attack with the Sword of Extermination.
If the target is a cursed spirit, it must make a DC 30 Constitution saving throw or be exorcised and die instantly.
Mahoraga makes one slam or sword of extermination attack against a target within range.

Mahoraga's wheel spins violently, immediately completing one turn of adaptation.

Conditions. 3 turns: immunity to the condition.

Soul Damage. 2 turns: regeneration also undoes hit point maximum reduction.

If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

biography.value: Nue Totality - Merged Chimera Agito — Ten Shadows shikigami. Summon cost: 16 Cursed Energy. AC and hit points scale with the summoner's proficiency bonus when summoned through the Ten Shadows features.

description.value: Agito is a Chimera formed from the Totality of Great Serpent, Mourn Tiger, and Round Deer infused into Nue and costs 16 cursed energy to summon.
Agito has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Agito has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.
Agito doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
Agito has a pool of Reverse Cursed Energy equal to its Charisma modifier times your proficiency bonus. Agito regains 10 healing towards its pool at the start of its turn.

Agito has a 10 feet aura of reverse cursed energy around it at all times. Agito can spend 10 healing from its RCT Pool for each creature within its aura at the start of its turn, healing them for that amount. This aura also functions as an antimagic aura for all creatures other than its summoner. A creature that attempts to use cursed energy must make a DC 15 Cursed Energy check or be unable to use cursed energy while they are within the aura. Agito can suppress this aura while concentrating.
Agito can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (2d4) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

If Agito moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, Agito can make another bite attack against it as a bonus action.

You can spend Cursed Energy up to your CE modifier to use Reverse Cursed Technique using Agito as a point of origin. You can use 10 points of healing for every 1 cursed energy spent. On a hit with electrified wings, you can spend 1 cursed energy to deal an additional 2 damage die and cause a creature that fails its save to also gain disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saves it makes for 1 minute. If you spend at least 3 CE this way, a creature that fails its save is paralyzed until the beginning of their next turn. A creature can repeat this save at the end of their turn.
The Agito makes two electrified wing attacks or a claw and bite attack or a bite or constrict attack.
If the target is the same size or smaller than Agito, the creature is grappled (escape DC 21). While grappled, the creature is also restrained and Agito can't constrict another target.

Deals an extra 27 (5d10) radiant damage if the target is a cursed spirit and the creature must succeed a DC 18 Constitution save or the target can't take reactions until the start of its turn. If in contact with water, all creatures within 15 feet are targeted by this attack.

All creatures within 30 feet must make a Cursed Energy saving throw. On a failure a creature takes 28 (8d6) psychic damage and is paralyzed until the end of their next turn. On a success they take half as much damage.
Agito can spend healing from its RCT Pool on a creature it touches. Agito can spend up to 10 times your proficiency bonus at once in increments of 10.
Agito attempts to grapple a creature within range and moves up to half its movement speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
